definitions.explanation: The group of people who oppose a specific plan, policy, or proposal, treated as one camp. Used of factions within an organization as well as of the public split over an issue.

examples.japanese: {反対派|はんたいは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of opponents is growing.

examples.japanese: {反対派|はんたいは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{耳|みみ}を{傾|かたむ}ける→耳を傾ける：06903_mimiwokatamukeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: We should listen to the opponents' views as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{反対派|はんたいは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{崩|くず}す→切り崩す：06844_kirikuzusu⟧かたち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The plan was pushed forward by breaking down the opposition.

notes:
⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧ (opposition) + the suffix 〜⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (faction, camp). The suffix is productive: ⟦{推進派|すいしんは}→推進派：30541_suishinha⟧ (the pro-promotion camp), ⟦{慎重派|しんちょうは}→慎重派：30555_shinchouha⟧ (the cautious camp), {改革派|かいかくは} (the reformists).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {反対派|はんたいは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧: opponents are numerous
- {反対派|はんたいは}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説得|せっとく}する→説得する：21139_settokusuru⟧: to persuade the opposition
- {反対派|はんたいは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抵抗|ていこう}→抵抗：03540_teikou⟧: resistance from the opposition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{賛成派|さんせいは}→賛成派：30540_sanseiha⟧: the camp in favor — the direct opposite
- ⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧: opposition party — a party out of power, not a stance on one issue
